result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial verification of Story 2 against the story, tech design, test plan, implementation, focused tests, and configured gates. Gates pass, but two production rendering paths still violate Story 2 contracts, so the story is not ready for handoff.

newFindings.title: Full-band boundary rendering still serves inference summaries before deterministic truncation
newFindings.evidence: AC-2.1 requires full-band tool-result shortening to use deterministic truncation with no model call. In `packages/lhc/src/domains/thread-view/internal/render.ts:86-97`, the at-or-behind-boundary path sets `short` from `ctx.toolResultSummaries.get(message.messageId)` before falling back to `deterministicTruncation(content)`. `packages/lhc/test/view-boundary.test.ts:243-245` locks this old behavior by expecting a ready summary verbatim for an abridged tail result. Therefore any in-threshold tool result with a ready provider-generated `tool_result_summary` can be served in the full-band boundary path instead of the deterministic truncation floor.

newFindings.title: Tail tool-call rendering still truncates recorded arguments
newFindings.evidence: AC-2.5 says tool-call arguments render as-is wherever a tool call appears. Turn composition uses `JSON.stringify(block["arguments"] ?? {})` directly in `packages/lhc/src/domains/turns/internal/compose.ts:102-107`, but tail rendering still applies `deterministicTruncation(JSON.stringify(...))` in `packages/lhc/src/domains/thread-view/internal/render.ts:70-76`. A direct render probe with a 240-character `cmd` argument returned `[tool call · exec] {"cmd":"xxxx...… [truncated 50 chars]` with `includesFull:false`, proving the current tail surface does not render the recorded arguments as-is. The focused Story 2 test only covers a small turn-composition argument at `packages/lhc/test/tool-result-rendering.test.ts:166-188`, so this path remains uncovered.

productionPathFindings: `packages/lhc/src/domains/thread-view/internal/render.ts` can serve ready `tool_result_summary` content in the at-or-behind-boundary full-band path instead of deterministic truncation.
`packages/lhc/src/domains/thread-view/internal/render.ts` truncates oversized tail tool-call arguments instead of rendering recorded arguments as-is.
additionalObservations: No fake adapter, placeholder provider path, or runtime shim was found in real app code for this story; provider doubles are confined to tests.
`pnpm run verify` and `pnpm run verify-all` exited 0 on clean serial runs; both printed `NOT-RAN: real-inference (LHC_OPENROUTER_KEY unset)`, and no Story 2 finding relies on that external path.
